## Build, watch or play

From this directory, run `./build.sh`, then `./watch.sh`. Use `./watch.sh --verify-only` for a verification without opening the player. Where a starting save is retained, `./play.sh --label "My attempt"` records an alternative human continuation and adds it to this report. Historical cases lacking a recording/save explain that limit instead of inventing playback.

## Evaluation and diagnosis

See the [overall assessment](overall-assessment.md). A CL1 Necromancer, the first reviewed
death on source `5cd2258dd78d`, spent most of its starting gold on armour and unidentified
rings, and left its Recall at Home. A teleport trap dropped it beside a crow, wild dogs and a
centipede. It used its only Phase Door and both Nether Bolts, routed the pack, then died to the
fast crow at 5 HP. It was carrying two known Cure Light Wounds that fleeing-mode caution never
offered to drink. These are source-checked mechanisms with native evidence. No reusable
original-C defect or rescue is established.
